when HTTP_REQUEST {
     # Enable auto buffer tuning on HTTP request(s).
     log local0. "Send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf] Receive Window: [TCP::recvwnd]"
     log local0. "HTTP request, auto buffer tuning enabled."
     TCP::autowin enable
     log local0. "Send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf] Receive Window: [TCP::recvwnd]"
 }

text:
TCP::autowin
Description
Sets the send and receive buffer dynamically in accordance with
measured connection parameters.
Syntax
TCP::autowin
Syntax
TCP
::
autowin
BOOL_VALUE
TCP::autowin
BOOL_VALUE
Return Value
None.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
# Enable auto buffer tuning on HTTP request(s).
log
local0.
"Send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf] Receive Window: [TCP::recvwnd]"
log
local0.
"HTTP request, auto buffer tuning enabled."
TCP
::
autowin
enable
log
local0.
"Send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf] Receive Window: [TCP::recvwnd]"
}
